description: Generates a brand-new 3D model (GLB) from a text prompt OR a source image, with TRELLIS.2 on Runware or with Tripo AI — use this when `search_models` finds no suitable existing asset and the user needs a custom one ("a low-poly cactus in a striped pot"). Returns a direct GLB download URL (expires ~5 minutes — download it immediately and self-host it) plus license/attribution metadata, ready for `rememberModelInstance(modelLoader, ...)` and AR placement. Providers (BYOK — billed to the USER'S own account, nothing is charged by SceneView): "trellis" = Microsoft TRELLIS.2 on Runware, needs `RUNWARE_API_KEY` (my.runware.ai/keys), roughly $0.01-0.03 per model as of November 2026, ~40-90 s, text→3D renders a FLUX concept image first; "tripo" = Tripo AI, needs `TRIPO_API_KEY` (platform.tripo3d.ai/api-keys), roughly $0.10-0.25 per fast and ~$0.41 per hd generation as of July 2026. Without `provider`, Tripo is used when `TRIPO_API_KEY` is set, otherwise TRELLIS.2 when `RUNWARE_API_KEY` is set. Quality tiers: "fast" (default — Tripo P1 low-poly, or TRELLIS.2 at 1024³) or "hd" (Tripo H3.1 quad topology, or TRELLIS.2 at 1536³ — slower, pricier). If no key is set, the tool returns setup instructions for both providers.

imageUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL of a source image to convert to 3D (image→3D). JPEG or PNG, max 20 MB. Provide exactly one of `prompt` or `imageUrl`.

prompt.description: Text description of the model to generate (text→3D), e.g. "a low-poly cactus in a striped pot". Max 1024 characters. Provide exactly one of `prompt` or `imageUrl`.

provider.description: "trellis": Microsoft TRELLIS.2 on Runware (`RUNWARE_API_KEY`, a few US cents per model, image-faithful PBR mesh). "tripo": Tripo AI (`TRIPO_API_KEY`). Omit to pick whichever key is configured (Tripo first).

quality.description: "fast" (default): Tripo P1 low-poly (~25-30 s) or TRELLIS.2 1024³ — cheap, AR-ready. "hd": Tripo H3.1 quad topology (up to ~100 s) or TRELLIS.2 1536³ — more detail, higher cost.

name: generate_3d_model
